sql: select 'order' k, market_ticker, created_at::text t, action||' '||side||' '||limit_price||'c x'||quantity||' '||status||' '||coalesce(cancel_reason,'') v from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and created_at > '2026-10-17 22:50' union all select 'fill', f.market_ticker, f.filled_at::text, f.action||' '||f.side||' '||f.price||'c x'||f.quantity from fills f join live_orders o on o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id where o.strategy='Alimm1' and f.filled_at > '2026-10-17 22:50' union all select 'snap', market_ticker, at::text, best_yes_bid||'/'||best_no_bid from (select distinct on (market_ticker) * from incentive_market_snapshots where market_ticker = 'KXTRUMPMENTION-26OCT19-CEAS' order by market_ticker, at desc) x union all select 'cnt', kind, max(at)::text, count(*)::text from incentive_collector_events where kind like 'book_sweep%' group by kind union all select 'sell', market_ticker, created_at::text, limit_price||'c x'||quantity||' '||status from live_orders where strategy='Alimm1' and action='sell' and status in ('resting','partial','submitted') union all select 'off', component, created_at::text, message from system_events where component='limm_resting_sell_off'
